verdict.rationale: PayPal documents an official MCP server that lets merchants use natural language from their MCP clients. A runtime probe confirms a live remote endpoint at mcp.paypal.com/mcp with OAuth (RFC 9728) protected-resource metadata, and the agent toolkit (published on npm) exposes PayPal API tools for MCP. Missing for 10: in-depth client connection and setup documentation in the evidence, plus independent community corroboration of real-world MCP usage.
